cosmogony.khattab: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺
cosmogony.arberry: And heaven -- We built it with might, and We extend it wide.
cosmogony.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).

cosmogony.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
cosmogony.saheeh: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
cosmogony.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out
cosmogony.arberry: And the earth -- We spread it forth; O excellent Smoothers!
cosmogony.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!

cosmogony.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانࣱ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡأَرۡضِ ٱئۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا أَوۡ كَرۡهࣰ ا قَالَتَآ أَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِينَ
cosmogony.saheeh: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
cosmogony.khattab: Then He turned towards the heaven when it was ˹still like˺ smoke, saying to it and to the earth, ‘Submit, willingly or unwillingly.’ They both responded, ‘We submit willingly.’
cosmogony.arberry: Then He lifted Himself to heaven when it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth, "Come willingly, or unwillingly!" They said, "We come willingly."
cosmogony.pickthall: Then turned He to the heaven when it was smoke, and said unto it and unto the earth: Come both of you, willingly or loth. They said: We come, obedient.

cosmogony.arabic: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَاتࣲ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَأَوۡحَىٰ فِي كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمۡرَهَاۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفۡظࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
cosmogony.saheeh: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
cosmogony.khattab: So He formed the heaven into seven heavens in two Days, assigning to each its mandate. And We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps ˹for beauty˺ and for protection. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing.”
cosmogony.arberry: So He determined them as seven heavens in two days, and revealed its commandment in every heaven.'
cosmogony.pickthall: Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower.

cosmogony.arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
cosmogony.saheeh: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
cosmogony.khattab: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it
cosmogony.arberry: What, are you stronger in constitution or the heaven He built?
cosmogony.pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?

cosmogony.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
cosmogony.saheeh: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
cosmogony.khattab: raising it high and forming it flawlessly
cosmogony.arberry: He lifted up its vault, and levelled it,
cosmogony.pickthall: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;

cosmogony.arabic: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
cosmogony.saheeh: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
cosmogony.khattab: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight
cosmogony.arberry: and darkened its night, and brought forth its forenoon;
cosmogony.pickthall: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.

cosmogony.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
cosmogony.saheeh: And after that He spread the earth.
cosmogony.khattab: As for the earth, He spread it out as well
cosmogony.arberry: and the earth-after that He spread it out,
cosmogony.pickthall: And after that He spread the earth,

cosmogony.arabic: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا
cosmogony.saheeh: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
cosmogony.khattab: bringing forth its water and pastures
cosmogony.arberry: therefrom brought forth its waters and its pastures,
cosmogony.pickthall: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,

cosmogony.arabic: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
cosmogony.saheeh: And the mountains He set firmly
cosmogony.khattab: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—
cosmogony.arberry: and the mountains He set firm,
cosmogony.pickthall: And He made fast the hills,

cosmogony.arabic: مَتَٰعࣰ ا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
cosmogony.saheeh: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
cosmogony.khattab: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals
cosmogony.arberry: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.
cosmogony.pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.

cosmogony.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يُغۡشِي ٱلَّيۡلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطۡلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثࣰ ا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتِۭ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُۗ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
cosmogony.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
cosmogony.khattab: Indeed your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He makes the day and night overlap in rapid succession. He created the sun, the moon, and the stars—all subjected by His command. The creation and the command belong to Him ˹alone˺. Blessed is Allah—Lord of all worlds
cosmogony.arberry: Surely your Lord is God, who created the heavens and the earth in six days -- then sat Himself upon the Throne, covering the day with the night it pursues urgently -- and the sun, and the moon, and the stars subservient, by His command. Verily, His are the creation and the command. Blessed be God, the Lord of all Being.
cosmogony.pickthall: Lo! your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then mounted He the Throne. He covereth the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it, and hath made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient by His command. His verily is all creation and commandment. Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

cosmogony.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيࣲّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
cosmogony.saheeh: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
cosmogony.khattab: It is Allah Who has created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. You have no protector or intercessor besides Him. Will you not then be mindful
cosmogony.arberry: God is He that created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, then seated Himself upon the Throne. Apart from Him, you have no protector neither mediator; will you not remember?
cosmogony.pickthall: Allah it is Who created the heavens and the earth, and that which is between them, in six Days. Then He mounted the Throne. Ye have not, beside Him, a protecting friend or mediator. Will ye not then remember?

cosmogony.arabic: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يَعۡرُجُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥٓ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
cosmogony.saheeh: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
cosmogony.khattab: He conducts every affair from the heavens to the earth, then it all ascends to Him on a Day whose length is a thousand years by your counting
cosmogony.arberry: He directs the affair from heaven to earth, then it goes up to Him in one day, whose measure is a thousand years of your counting.
cosmogony.pickthall: He directeth the ordinance from the heaven unto the earth; then it ascendeth unto Him in a Day, whereof the measure is a thousand years of that ye reckon.

cosmogony.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏
cosmogony.saheeh: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
cosmogony.khattab: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless
cosmogony.arberry: What, have they not beheld heaven above them, how We have built it, and decked it out fair, and it has no cracks?
cosmogony.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?

cosmogony.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِرَٰشࣰ ا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءࣰ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقࣰ ا لَّكُمۡۖ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادࣰ ا وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
cosmogony.saheeh: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
cosmogony.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who has made the earth a place of settlement for you and the sky a canopy; and sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for you. So do not knowingly set up equals to Allah ˹in worship˺
cosmogony.arberry: who assigned to you the earth for a couch, and heaven for an edifice, and sent down out of heaven water, wherewith He brought forth fruits for your provision; so set not up compeers to God wittingly.
cosmogony.pickthall: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

passing-beyond.arabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ‏
passing-beyond.saheeh: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
passing-beyond.khattab: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
passing-beyond.arberry: O tribe of jinn and of men, if you are able to pass through the confines of heaven and earth, pass through them! You shall not pass through except with an authority.
passing-beyond.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.

passing-beyond.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
passing-beyond.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
passing-beyond.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
passing-beyond.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?
passing-beyond.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

passing-beyond.arabic: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظࣱ مِّن نَّارࣲ وَنُحَاسࣱ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
passing-beyond.saheeh: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
passing-beyond.khattab: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another
passing-beyond.arberry: Against you shall be loosed a flame of fire, and molten brass; and you shall not be helped.
passing-beyond.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ
passing-beyond.saheeh: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
passing-beyond.khattab: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend
passing-beyond.arberry: Though We opened to them a gate in heaven, and still they mounted through it,
passing-beyond.pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,

passing-beyond.arabic: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمࣱ مَّسۡحُورُونَ
passing-beyond.saheeh: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
passing-beyond.khattab: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”
passing-beyond.arberry: yet would they say, 'Our eyes have been dazzled; nay, we are a people bewitched!'
passing-beyond.pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجࣰ ا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
passing-beyond.saheeh: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
passing-beyond.khattab: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see
passing-beyond.arberry: We have set in heaven constellations and decked them out fair to the beholders,
passing-beyond.pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَحَفِظۡنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ رَّجِيمٍ
passing-beyond.saheeh: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
passing-beyond.khattab: And We protected it from every accursed devil
passing-beyond.arberry: and guarded them from every accursed Satan
passing-beyond.pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,

passing-beyond.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
passing-beyond.saheeh: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
passing-beyond.khattab: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare
passing-beyond.arberry: excepting such as listens by stealth -- and he is pursued by a manifest flame.
passing-beyond.pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.

passing-beyond.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
passing-beyond.saheeh: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
passing-beyond.khattab: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration
passing-beyond.arberry: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars
passing-beyond.pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;

passing-beyond.arabic: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏
passing-beyond.saheeh: And as protection against every rebellious devil
passing-beyond.khattab: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil
passing-beyond.arberry: and to preserve against every rebel Satan;
passing-beyond.pickthall: With security from every froward devil.

passing-beyond.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
passing-beyond.saheeh: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
passing-beyond.khattab: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side
passing-beyond.arberry: they listen not to the High Council, for they are pelted from every side,
passing-beyond.pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,

passing-beyond.arabic: دُحُورࣰ اۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ وَاصِبٌ
passing-beyond.saheeh: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
passing-beyond.khattab: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment
passing-beyond.arberry: rejected, and theirs is an everlasting chastisement,
passing-beyond.pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;

passing-beyond.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
passing-beyond.saheeh: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
passing-beyond.khattab: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare
passing-beyond.arberry: except such as snatches a fragment, and he is pursued by a piercing flame.
passing-beyond.pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومࣰ ا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
passing-beyond.saheeh: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
passing-beyond.khattab: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze
passing-beyond.arberry: And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and made them things to stone Satans; and We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blaze.
passing-beyond.pickthall: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا
passing-beyond.saheeh: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
passing-beyond.khattab: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
passing-beyond.arberry: And we stretched towards heaven, but we found it filled with terrible guards and meteors.
passing-beyond.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا
passing-beyond.saheeh: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
passing-beyond.khattab: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them
passing-beyond.arberry: We would sit there on seats to hear; but any listening now finds a meteor in wait for him.
passing-beyond.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;

passing-beyond.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا
passing-beyond.saheeh: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
passing-beyond.khattab: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
passing-beyond.arberry: And so we know not whether evil is intended for those in the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them rectitude.
passing-beyond.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.

passing-beyond.arabic: أَوۡ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيۡتࣱ مِّن زُخۡرُفٍ أَوۡ تَرۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيۡنَا كِتَٰبࣰ ا نَّقۡرَؤُهُۥۗ قُلۡ سُبۡحَانَ رَبِّي هَلۡ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرࣰ ا رَّسُولࣰ ا
passing-beyond.saheeh: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
passing-beyond.khattab: or until you have a house of gold, or you ascend into heaven—and even then we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book that we can read.” Say, “Glory be to my Lord! Am I not only a human messenger?”
passing-beyond.arberry: or till thou possessest a house of gold ornament, or till thou goest up into heaven; and we will not believe thy going up till thou bringest down on us a book that we may read. Say: 'Glory be to my Lord. Am I aught but a mortal, a Messenger?'
passing-beyond.pickthall: Or thou have a house of gold; or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord be Glorified! Am I aught save a mortal messenger?

passing-beyond.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓاْ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرࣰ ا رَّسُولࣰ ا
passing-beyond.saheeh: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?"
passing-beyond.khattab: And nothing has prevented people from believing when guidance comes to them except their protest: “Has Allah sent a human as a messenger?”
passing-beyond.arberry: And naught prevented men from believing when the guidance came to them, but that they said, 'Has God sent forth a mortal as Messenger?'
passing-beyond.pickthall: And naught prevented mankind from believing when the guidance came unto them save that they said: Hath Allah sent a mortal as (His) messenger?

passing-beyond.arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣱ يَمۡشُونَ مُطۡمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكࣰ ا رَّسُولࣰ ا
passing-beyond.saheeh: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
passing-beyond.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Had there been angels walking the earth, well settled, We would have surely sent down for them an angel from heaven as a messenger.”
passing-beyond.arberry: Say: 'Had there been in the earth angels walking. at peace, We would have sent down upon them out of heaven an angel as Messenger.'
passing-beyond.pickthall: Say: If there were in the earth angels walking secure, We had sent down for them from heaven an angel as messenger.

passing-beyond.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيۡكَ إِعۡرَاضُهُمۡ فَإِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتَ أَن تَبۡتَغِيَ نَفَقࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَوۡ سُلَّمࣰ ا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأۡتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةࣲۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰۚ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
passing-beyond.saheeh: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allah had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant.
passing-beyond.khattab: If you find their denial unbearable, then build—if you can—a tunnel through the earth or stairs to the sky to bring them a ˹more compelling˺ sign. Had Allah so willed, He could have guided them all. So do not be one of those ignorant ˹of this fact˺
passing-beyond.arberry: And if their turning away is distressful for thee, why, if thou canst seek out a hole in the earth, or a ladder in heaven, to bring them some sign but had God willed, He would have gathered them to the guidance; so be not thou one of the ignorant.
passing-beyond.pickthall: And if their aversion is grievous unto thee, then, if thou canst, seek a way down into the earth or a ladder unto the sky that thou mayst bring unto them a portent (to convince them all)! - If Allah willed, He could have brought them all together to the guidance - So be not thou among the foolish ones.

the-worlds.saheeh: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
the-worlds.khattab: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
the-worlds.arberry: In the Name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate
the-worlds.pickthall: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

the-worlds.saheeh: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
the-worlds.khattab: All praise is for Allah—Lord of all worlds
the-worlds.arberry: Praise belongs to God, the Lord of all Being,
the-worlds.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

the-worlds.saheeh: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
the-worlds.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”
the-worlds.arberry: Pharaoh said, 'And what is the Lord of all Being?'
the-worlds.pickthall: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?

the-worlds.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
the-worlds.saheeh: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
the-worlds.khattab: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”
the-worlds.arberry: He said, 'The Lord of the heavens and earth, and what between them is, if you have faith.'
the-worlds.pickthall: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.

the-worlds.arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
the-worlds.saheeh: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.
the-worlds.khattab: O Children of Israel! Remember ˹all˺ the favours I granted you and how I honoured you above the others
the-worlds.arberry: Children of Israel, remember My blessing wherewith I blessed you, and that I have preferred you above all beings;
the-worlds.pickthall: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.

the-worlds.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
the-worlds.saheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
the-worlds.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds
the-worlds.arberry: So to God belongs praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, Lord of all Being.
the-worlds.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.

the-worlds.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
the-worlds.saheeh: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
the-worlds.khattab: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
the-worlds.arberry: His is the Domination an the heavens and the earth; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.
the-worlds.pickthall: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

the-worlds.arabic: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْۚ وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
the-worlds.saheeh: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
the-worlds.khattab: So the wrongdoers were utterly uprooted. And all praise is for Allah—Lord of all worlds
the-worlds.arberry: So the last remnant of the people who did evil was cut off. Praise belongs to God the Lord of all Being.
the-worlds.pickthall: So of the people who did wrong the last remnant was cut off. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!

the-worlds.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يُغۡشِي ٱلَّيۡلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطۡلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثࣰ ا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتِۭ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُۗ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
the-worlds.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
the-worlds.khattab: Indeed your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He makes the day and night overlap in rapid succession. He created the sun, the moon, and the stars—all subjected by His command. The creation and the command belong to Him ˹alone˺. Blessed is Allah—Lord of all worlds
the-worlds.arberry: Surely your Lord is God, who created the heavens and the earth in six days -- then sat Himself upon the Throne, covering the day with the night it pursues urgently -- and the sun, and the moon, and the stars subservient, by His command. Verily, His are the creation and the command. Blessed be God, the Lord of all Being.
the-worlds.pickthall: Lo! your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then mounted He the Throne. He covereth the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it, and hath made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient by His command. His verily is all creation and commandment. Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

communities.arabic: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرࣲ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيۡهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمۡثَالُكُمۚ مَّا فَرَّطۡنَا فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن شَيۡءࣲۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يُحۡشَرُونَ
communities.saheeh: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
communities.khattab: All living beings roaming the earth and winged birds soaring in the sky are communities like yourselves. We have left nothing out of the Record. Then to their Lord they will be gathered all together
communities.arberry: No creature is there crawling on the earth, no bird flying with its wings, but they are nations like unto yourselves. We have neglected nothing in the Book; then to their Lord they shall be mustered.
communities.pickthall: There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you. We have neglected nothing in the Book (of Our decrees). Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.

communities.arabic: وَأَوۡحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحۡلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِي مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتࣰ ا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُونَ
communities.saheeh: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
communities.khattab: And your Lord inspired the bees: “Make ˹your˺ homes in the mountains, the trees, and in what people construct
communities.arberry: And thy Lord revealed unto the bees, saying: 'Take unto yourselves, of the mountains, houses, and of the trees, and of what they are building.
communities.pickthall: And thy Lord inspired the bee, saying: Choose thou habitations in the hills and in the trees and in that which they thatch;

communities.arabic: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسۡلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلࣰ اۚ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابࣱ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءࣱ لِّلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
communities.saheeh: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
communities.khattab: and feed from ˹the flower of˺ any fruit ˹you please˺ and follow the ways your Lord has made easy for you.” From their bellies comes forth liquid of varying colours, in which there is healing for people. Surely in this is a sign for those who reflect
communities.arberry: Then eat of all manner of fruit, and follow the ways of your Lord easy to go upon.' Then comes there forth out of their bellies a drink of diverse hues wherein is healing for men. Surely in that is a sign for a people who reflect.
communities.pickthall: Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.

communities.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
communities.saheeh: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
communities.khattab: And David was succeeded by Solomon, who said, “O people! We have been taught the language of birds, and been given everything ˹we need˺. This is indeed a great privilege.”
communities.arberry: And Solomon was David's heir, and he said, 'Men, we have been taught the speech of the birds, and we have been given of everything; surely this is indeed the manifest bounty.'
communities.pickthall: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.

communities.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
communities.saheeh: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
communities.khattab: Solomon’s forces of jinn, humans, and birds were rallied for him, perfectly organized
communities.arberry: And his hosts were mustered to Solomon, jinn, men and birds, duly disposed;
communities.pickthall: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;

communities.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةࣱ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
communities.saheeh: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
communities.khattab: And when they came across a valley of ants, an ant warned, “O ants! Go quickly into your homes so Solomon and his armies do not crush you, unknowingly.”
communities.arberry: till, when they came on the Valley of Ants, an ant said, 'Ants, enter your dwelling-places, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you, being unaware!'
communities.pickthall: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.

communities.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكࣰ ا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
communities.saheeh: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
communities.khattab: So Solomon smiled in amusement at her words, and prayed, “My Lord! Inspire me to ˹always˺ be thankful for Your favours which You have blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please you. Admit me, by Your mercy, into ˹the company of˺ Your righteous servants.”
communities.arberry: But he smiled, laughing at its words, and he said, 'My Lord, dispose me that I may be thankful for Thy blessing wherewith Thou hast blessed me and my father and mother, and that I may do righteousness well-pleasing to Thee; and do Thou admit me, by Thy mercy, amongst Thy righteous servants.'
communities.pickthall: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.

communities.arabic: ۞وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضۡلࣰ اۖ يَٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيۡرَۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلۡحَدِيدَ
communities.saheeh: And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,
communities.khattab: Indeed, We granted David a ˹great˺ privilege from Us, ˹commanding:˺ “O mountains! Echo his hymns! And the birds as well.” We made iron mouldable for him
communities.arberry: And We gave David bounty from Us: 'O you mountains, echo God's praises with him, and you birds!' And We softened for him iron:
communities.pickthall: And assuredly We gave David grace from Us, (saying): O ye hills and birds, echo his psalms of praise! And We made the iron supple unto him,

communities.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
communities.saheeh: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
communities.khattab: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise
communities.arberry: With him We subjected the mountains to give glory at evening and sunrise,
communities.pickthall: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,

communities.saheeh: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
communities.khattab: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺
communities.arberry: and the birds, duly mustered, every one to him reverting;
communities.pickthall: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.

communities.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلطَّيۡرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲۖ كُلࣱّ قَدۡ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسۡبِيحَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
communities.saheeh: Do you not see that Allah is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allah is Knowing of what they do.
communities.khattab: Do you not see that Allah is glorified by all those in the heavens and the earth, even the birds as they soar? Each ˹instinctively˺ knows their manner of prayer and glorification. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all they do
communities.arberry: Hast thou not seen how that whatsoever is in the heavens and in the earth extols God, and the birds spreading their wings? Each -- He knows its prayer and its extolling; and God knows the things they do.
communities.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah, He it is Whom all who are in the heavens and the earth praise, and the birds in their flight? Of each He knoweth verily the worship and the praise; and Allah is Aware of what they do.

communities.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبۡعُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفۡقَهُونَ تَسۡبِيحَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورࣰ ا
communities.saheeh: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
communities.khattab: The seven heavens, the earth, and all those in them glorify Him. There is not a single thing that does not glorify His praises—but you ˹simply˺ cannot comprehend their glorification. He is indeed Most Forbearing, All-Forgiving
communities.arberry: The seven heavens and the earth, and whosoever in them is, extol Him; nothing is, that does not proclaim His praise, but you do not understand their extolling. Surely He is All-clement, All-forgiving.
communities.pickthall: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.

life-and-water.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقࣰ ا فَفَتَقۡنَٰهُمَاۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّۚ أَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
life-and-water.saheeh: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
life-and-water.khattab: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and earth were ˹once˺ one mass then We split them apart? And We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe
life-and-water.arberry: Have not the unbelievers then beheld that the heavens and the earth were a mass all sewn up, and then We unstitched them and of water fashioned every living thing? Will they not believe?
life-and-water.pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?

life-and-water.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةࣲ مِّن مَّآءࣲۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ بَطۡنِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ رِجۡلَيۡنِ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعࣲۚ يَخۡلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
life-and-water.saheeh: Allah has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
life-and-water.khattab: And Allah has created from water every living creature. Some of them crawl on their bellies, some walk on two legs, and some walk on four. Allah creates whatever He wills. Surely Allah is Most Capable of everything
life-and-water.arberry: God has created every beast of water, and some of them go upon their bellies, and some of them go upon two feet, and some of them go upon four; God creates whatever He will; God is powerful over everything.
life-and-water.pickthall: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

life-and-water.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرࣰ ا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبࣰ ا وَصِهۡرࣰ اۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرࣰ ا
life-and-water.saheeh: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
life-and-water.khattab: And He is the One Who creates human beings from a ˹humble˺ liquid, then establishes for them bonds of kinship and marriage. For your Lord is Most Capable
life-and-water.arberry: And it is He who created of water a mortal, and made him kindred of blood and marriage; thy Lord is All-powerful.
life-and-water.pickthall: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.

life-and-water.saheeh: So let man observe from what he was created.
life-and-water.khattab: Let people then consider what they were created from
life-and-water.arberry: So let man consider of what he was created;
life-and-water.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.

life-and-water.saheeh: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
life-and-water.khattab: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid
life-and-water.arberry: he was created of gushing water
life-and-water.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid

life-and-water.saheeh: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
life-and-water.khattab: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage
life-and-water.arberry: issuing between the loins and the breast-bones.
life-and-water.pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

life-and-water.saheeh: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
life-and-water.khattab: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺
life-and-water.arberry: Surely He is able to bring him back
life-and-water.pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

life-and-water.saheeh: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
life-and-water.khattab: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺
life-and-water.arberry: We created you; therefore why will you not believe?
life-and-water.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?

life-and-water.saheeh: Have you seen that which you emit?
life-and-water.khattab: Have you considered what you ejaculate
life-and-water.arberry: Have you considered the seed you spill?
life-and-water.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit?

life-and-water.saheeh: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
life-and-water.khattab: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so
life-and-water.arberry: Do you yourselves create it, or are We the Creators?
life-and-water.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?

life-and-water.arabic: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
life-and-water.saheeh: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
life-and-water.khattab: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented
life-and-water.arberry: We have decreed among you Death; We shall not be outstripped;
life-and-water.pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,

life-and-water.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
life-and-water.saheeh: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
life-and-water.khattab: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you
life-and-water.arberry: that We may exchange the likes of you, and make you to grow again in a fashion you know not.
life-and-water.pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.

life-and-water.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
life-and-water.saheeh: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
life-and-water.khattab: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful
life-and-water.arberry: You have known the first growth; so why will you not remember?
life-and-water.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?

gathering.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةࣲۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمۡعِهِمۡ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرࣱ‏
gathering.saheeh: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
gathering.khattab: And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and all living beings He dispersed throughout both. And He is Most Capable of bringing all together whenever He wills
gathering.arberry: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and the crawling things He has scattered abroad in them; and He is able to gather them whenever He will.
gathering.pickthall: And of His portents is the creation of the heaven and the earth, and of whatever beasts He hath dispersed therein. And He is Able to gather them when He will.

gathering.arabic: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرࣲ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيۡهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمۡثَالُكُمۚ مَّا فَرَّطۡنَا فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن شَيۡءࣲۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يُحۡشَرُونَ
gathering.saheeh: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
gathering.khattab: All living beings roaming the earth and winged birds soaring in the sky are communities like yourselves. We have left nothing out of the Record. Then to their Lord they will be gathered all together
gathering.arberry: No creature is there crawling on the earth, no bird flying with its wings, but they are nations like unto yourselves. We have neglected nothing in the Book; then to their Lord they shall be mustered.
gathering.pickthall: There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you. We have neglected nothing in the Book (of Our decrees). Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.

gathering.saheeh: And when the wild beasts are gathered
gathering.khattab: and when wild beasts are gathered together
gathering.arberry: when the savage beasts shall be mustered,
gathering.pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,

gathering.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوۡهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
gathering.saheeh: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
gathering.khattab: And ˹beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and all those in the heavens and all those on the earth will be horrified ˹to the point of death˺, except those Allah wills ˹to spare˺. And all will come before Him, fully humbled
gathering.arberry: On the day the Trumpet is blown, and terrified is whosoever is in the heavens and earth, excepting whom God wills, and every one shall come to Him, all utterly abject;
gathering.pickthall: And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and the earth will start in fear, save him whom Allah willeth. And all come unto Him, humbled.

gathering.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلۡجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَارِزَةࣰ وَحَشَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَمۡ نُغَادِرۡ مِنۡهُمۡ أَحَدࣰ ا
gathering.saheeh: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
gathering.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will blow the mountains away, and you will see the earth laid bare. And We will gather all ˹humankind˺, leaving none behind
gathering.arberry: And on the day We shall set the mountains in motion, and thou seest the earth coming forth, and We muster them so that We leave not so much as one of them behind;
gathering.pickthall: And (bethink you of) the Day when we remove the hills and ye see the earth emerging, and We gather them together so as to leave not one of them behind.
